messages:
Ruth (docs): Quick flag: customer hit a 422 on POST /v1/sessions/create. Our API ref example shows `user_id` as string and `ttl` in seconds. Runtime actually expects `user` (object with `id`) and `expires_at` ISO timestamp. The current curl/snippets are wrong.

Hector (eng): Yep, we changed the session contract when adding multi-identity support. OpenAPI wasn't updated. Server rejects `user_id` with unknown field error. Also response example shows 200 with `session_token` but we now return 201 and `session_ref`.

Mina (sdk): The SDK convenience wrapper still accepts `user_id` for backward compatibility but logs a deprecation warning. Docs need to show the canonical shape: {"user":{"id":"usr_123","type":"team"},"expires_at":"2026-04-01T12:00:00Z"}.

Ruth (docs): Draft replacement curl snippet: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/create" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"user":{"id":"usr_123","type":"team"},"expires_at":"2026-04-01T12:00:00Z"}'

Eve (support): Customer is unblocked if we provide the updated example. They used the docs verbatim. Please push hotfix.

Hector (eng): I'll add an OpenAPI patch and a small compatibility mapper in the sessions service that accepts `user_id` for two releases and emits a server warning. Also will update response example to 201 + {"session_ref":"sess_ABC","status":"created"}.

Mina (sdk): I'll update the JS/Python snippets in the SDK READMEs and add a test case for the new object shape. Will reference the docs PR.

Ruth (docs): Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4700 — includes OpenAPI update, new curl/py/js snippets, and a short migration note about `user_id` -> `user.id`. Requesting Hector + Mina review.

docs-bot: PR opened by Ruth (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4700 labels: docs,hotfix

Hector (eng): Reviewing. If tests pass I'll merge and deploy a docs hotfix. Compatibility mapper PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sessions/pull/88 (draft).

Mina (sdk): LGTM on snippets. I'll open SDK PRs after docs merged.

Ruth (docs): Action items: [x] update OpenAPI and snippets, [ ] add release-note migration blurb, [ ] link SDK PRs once opened. Will post an update to #customer-success when merged.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4700 (merged by Hector)

Mina (sdk): Opened js-sdk#722 and py-sdk#310 with snippet updates and tests. Linking from docs page.

Eve (support): Customer confirmed success with new snippet. Closing thread.
